name: Transfer funds between a customer's bank accounts
description: Customers should be able to transfer valid amounts without losing or creating money.

steps.name: the customer is logged into ParaBank
the customer has access to two bank accounts

elements.name: Successfully transfer funds between accounts

steps.name: the customer is on the Transfer Funds page
the customer enters the amount "1"
the customer selects an account with sufficient funds
the customer selects a different destination account
clicks the Transfer button
the message "Transfer Complete!" should be displayed
the source account balance should decrease by "1"
the destination account balance should increase by "1"
the customer is logged into ParaBank
the customer has access to two bank accounts

elements.name: Transfer funds with an empty amount

the customer is logged into ParaBank
the customer has access to two bank accounts
